map.用等宽字符拼出 5 行高的像素大字，适合命令行横幅、项目 README 的开头装: Use monospaced characters to spell 5-line-high pixel large letters, suitable for command-line banners and the opening decoration of a project README. Only supports uppercase A–Z and digits 0–9; other characters are left blank.
map.ASCII 艺术字按点阵字库映射：每个字符由 5 行 × 5 至 7 列的 0: ASCII art maps by a dot-matrix font: each character is represented by a 5-row × 5-to-7-column bitmap of 0 and 1, replacing 1 with a placeholder character (such as # or @) row by row and 0 with a space; output width = character count × single-character column width + spacing × (character count − 1); only supports uppercase A to Z and digits 0 to 9, and other characters are padded with blank blocks.
map.每个字符为 5 行 × 5 列像素网格，用填充字符（默认 #）表示点亮、空格表示: Each character is a 5-row × 5-column pixel grid, using a fill character (default #) for lit pixels and a space for off pixels, with custom fill character support.

Built-in 5×5 dot-matrix font (A–Z, 0–9). The dot matrix of letter A is: row 1 .###., row 2 #...#, row 3 #####, row 4 #...#, row 5 #...# (1 means solid, 0 means blank). Inputting "HI" outputs H and I dot matrices side by side as a character drawing.

map.1 表示该像素实心（渲染为 # 或 ●），0 表示空白。整字由 5 行×5 列共: 1 means the pixel is solid (rendered as # or ●), 0 means blank. The whole glyph is described by 5 rows × 5 columns = 25 pixels in total, separated by semicolons within a row and by newlines between rows.
